pairs.registryProposal: negative-claims-are-pinned is written about pinning a document's wording. It does not say what to do when the negative claim lives in a code comment and a gate over the build output can check the truth itself, which is stronger than pinning the wording. A sentence saying that an artifact-level forbidden-substring gate satisfies the technique would make this case easy to judge.
